grammar_title: 过去分词作定语 和 作宾语补足语(have/get sth done · 感官/使役动词 + 宾语 + done)
source: 人教版2019必修二 Unit 4 Discovering Useful Structures:过去分词作定语(前置/后置,表被动·完成)与作宾语补足语(have/get/see/hear/find/want/make + 宾语 + 过去分词)。句子地道、过去分词形式唯一成立(doing 主动进行 / to do / do 均排除)。

points.point: 过去分词作定语(前置 broken window / 后置 soldiers wounded)
points.overview: 过去分词修饰名词,表被动或完成,相当于定语从句。单个分词前置(a broken window),带短语后置(soldiers wounded in the war)。与表主动进行的现在分词(-ing)对照:被名词承受的动作用过去分词。
have/get + 宾语 + 过去分词,表示让别人做某事或某事被完成(get our car battery charged / had a copy boxed)。宾语与分词是被动关系,所以用过去分词,不用 doing/to do。

points.point: 感官/使役动词 + 宾语 + 过去分词(see/hear/find/want/make)
points.overview: see/hear/find/want/make/keep + 宾语 + 过去分词,作宾语补足语,宾语与分词是被动关系(heard it announced / had her eyes fixed / want it done)。与表主动的 doing/动词原形对照。

questions.stem: We looked up at the ____ window and wondered who had thrown the stone.
questions.explanation: window 被打破、表被动完成,过去分词 broken 作前置定语。

questions.stem: The ____ visitors sat down on a bench to rest their feet.
questions.explanation: visitors 感到累、被动状态,tired 作前置定语;tiring 表'令人疲惫的'语义不通。

questions.stem: The soldiers ____ in the First World War were cared for by the family.
questions.explanation: soldiers 被打伤、带短语后置,过去分词 wounded 作后置定语。

questions.stem: Loch Ness is a lake ____ by beautiful natural landscape.
questions.explanation: lake 被环绕,过去分词短语 surrounded by... 作后置定语。

questions.stem: They sent us a copy ____ in a strong wooden box.
questions.explanation: copy 被装箱,过去分词短语 boxed in... 作后置定语。

questions.stem: The castles ____ by the Normans can still be seen across England.
questions.explanation: castles 被建造,过去分词短语 built by... 作后置定语。

questions.stem: We followed a ____ trip that took us to three historic towns.
questions.explanation: trip 被精心安排,过去分词 well-organised 作前置定语。

questions.stem: Many words ____ by the Vikings are still used in English today.
questions.explanation: words 被引入,过去分词短语 introduced by... 作后置定语。

questions.stem: The green hills ____ with sheep made a peaceful picture.
questions.explanation: hills 被点缀,过去分词短语 dotted with... 作后置定语。

questions.stem: Most people just use the ____ name 'the UK'.
questions.explanation: name 被缩短,过去分词 shortened 作前置定语。

questions.stem: The flag ____ as the Union Jack is shared by the four countries.
questions.explanation: be known as 固定搭配,过去分词短语 known as... 作后置定语。

questions.stem: There were lots of museums full of ancient relics ____ from all over the UK.
questions.explanation: relics 被收集,过去分词短语 collected from... 作后置定语。

questions.stem: We saw beautifully ____ stars arrive at the gallery opening.
questions.explanation: stars 被打扮,过去分词 dressed(beautifully dressed)作前置定语。

questions.stem: The names of many places ____ behind by the Vikings still exist.
questions.explanation: places(的名字)被留下,过去分词短语 left behind 作后置定语。

questions.stem: A country ____ by four different groups has a very rich history.
questions.explanation: country 被征服,过去分词短语 conquered by... 作后置定语。

questions.stem: She bought a copy of the famous painting ____ in London.
questions.explanation: copy 被印制,过去分词短语 printed in... 作后置定语。

questions.stem: The ____ guidebook helped us find every historic site easily.
questions.explanation: guidebook 被更新,过去分词 updated 作前置定语。

questions.stem: Cameras ____ on the hill recorded the lake all day long.
questions.explanation: cameras 被架设,过去分词短语 positioned on... 作后置定语。

questions.stem: The new words ____ by the Normans came mostly from French.
questions.explanation: words 被诺曼人带入,过去分词短语 brought by... 作后置定语。

questions.stem: Towns and roads ____ by the Romans were a great achievement.
questions.explanation: towns and roads 被建造,过去分词短语 built by... 作后置定语。

questions.stem: Judy and I had our car ____ in an underground car park.
questions.explanation: have sth done:car 被停放,过去分词 parked 作宾补。

questions.stem: Near the square we could get our car battery ____ quickly.
questions.explanation: get sth done:battery 被充电,过去分词 charged 作宾补。

questions.stem: She had a copy of the painting ____ to keep it safe on the way.
questions.explanation: have sth done:copy 被装箱,过去分词 boxed 作宾补。

questions.stem: We must get the old castle wall ____ before winter comes.
questions.explanation: get sth done:wall 被修理,过去分词 repaired 作宾补。

questions.stem: The hostel had the visitors' bags ____ at the front desk.
questions.explanation: have sth done:bags 被检查,过去分词 checked 作宾补。

questions.stem: I'd like to have these old photos of the temple ____ this week.
questions.explanation: have sth done:photos 被冲印,过去分词 printed 作宾补。

questions.stem: Before the trip, we got our tickets ____ at the station office.
questions.explanation: get sth done:tickets 被预订,过去分词 booked 作宾补。

questions.stem: The museum had the ancient relics ____ in glass cases.
questions.explanation: have sth done:relics 被展示,过去分词 displayed 作宾补。

questions.stem: She wanted to get the guidebook ____ into Chinese for her parents.
questions.explanation: get sth done:guidebook 被翻译,过去分词 translated 作宾补。

questions.stem: We had our audio guides ____ at the service desk inside the gallery.
questions.explanation: have sth done:guides 被领取,过去分词 collected 作宾补。

questions.stem: The family had their old mansion ____ in soft yellow light at night.
questions.explanation: have sth done:mansion 被照亮,过去分词 lit 作宾补。

questions.stem: He got his name ____ in the family tree, just like his ancestors.
questions.explanation: get sth done:name 被记录,过去分词 recorded 作宾补。

questions.stem: Before leaving Pingyao, Paul had a few snacks ____ for the long train ride.
questions.explanation: have sth done:snacks 被打包,过去分词 packed 作宾补。

questions.stem: We should get the courtyard floor ____ before the guests arrive.
questions.explanation: get sth done:floor 被打扫,过去分词 cleaned 作宾补。

questions.stem: The shop will have your purchase ____ to your hotel for free.
questions.explanation: have sth done:purchase 被送达,过去分词 delivered 作宾补。

questions.stem: They had the historic bridge ____ exactly as it had once looked.
questions.explanation: have sth done:bridge 被重建,过去分词 rebuilt 作宾补。

questions.stem: I want to get my room ____ before I go out to see the city wall.
questions.explanation: get sth done:room 被整理,过去分词 tidied 作宾补。

questions.stem: The hotel had a map of the old town ____ for every guest.
questions.explanation: have sth done:map 被准备好,过去分词 prepared 作宾补。

questions.stem: She got the broken camera ____ just in time for the trip to Scotland.
questions.explanation: get sth done:camera 被修好,过去分词 fixed 作宾补。

questions.stem: We had our coats and bags ____ before entering the National Gallery.
questions.explanation: have sth done:coats and bags 被寄存,过去分词 stored 作宾补。

questions.stem: At the service desk, we heard it ____ that no audio guides were left.
questions.explanation: hear sth done:it(消息)被宣布,过去分词 announced 作宾补。

questions.stem: Judy had her eyes ____ on Van Gogh's Sunflowers for a long time.
questions.explanation: have sth done:eyes 被定住,过去分词 fixed 作宾补。

questions.stem: We found ourselves ____ by the huge crowd at the entrance.
questions.explanation: find sb done:ourselves 被惊到,过去分词 surprised 作宾补。

questions.stem: The guide wanted the relics ____ exactly where they had been found.
questions.explanation: want sth done:relics 被保留,过去分词 kept 作宾补。

questions.stem: Standing on the wall, we saw the whole town ____ in golden evening light.
questions.explanation: see sth done:town 被笼罩,过去分词 bathed 作宾补。

questions.stem: She heard her family name ____ aloud during the temple ceremony.
questions.explanation: hear sth done:name 被叫到,过去分词 called 作宾补。

questions.stem: The receptionist found the guest book ____ open at the right page.
questions.explanation: find sth done:book 被翻开放着,过去分词 left 作宾补。

questions.stem: Visitors want the historic buildings ____ for future generations.
questions.explanation: want sth done:buildings 被保护,过去分词 protected 作宾补。

questions.stem: We watched the old gate slowly ____ by the workers at sunset.
questions.explanation: watch sth done:gate 被关上(强调被动),过去分词 closed 作宾补。

questions.stem: From the hill, they kept the lake ____ in view all afternoon.
questions.explanation: keep sth done:lake 被保持在视野中,过去分词 held 作宾补。

questions.stem: He found the museum doors ____ when he arrived early in the morning.
questions.explanation: find sth done:doors 被锁着,过去分词 locked 作宾补。

questions.stem: The teacher wanted the report on British history ____ by Friday.
questions.explanation: want sth done:report 被完成,过去分词 finished 作宾补。

questions.stem: At the entrance, I heard my ticket number ____ over the speaker.
questions.explanation: hear sth done:number 被读出,过去分词 read(/red/)作宾补。

questions.stem: The crowd saw the famous painting finally ____ to a safer wall.
questions.explanation: see sth done:painting 被移动,过去分词 moved 作宾补。

questions.stem: She wanted her photos of Loch Ness ____ in a small album.
questions.explanation: want sth done:photos 被整理,过去分词 arranged 作宾补。

questions.stem: We found the courtyard beautifully ____ with red lanterns for the feast.
questions.explanation: find sth done:courtyard 被装饰,过去分词 decorated 作宾补。

questions.stem: The visitors heard the old story ____ again by a local guide.
questions.explanation: hear sth done:story 被讲述,过去分词 told 作宾补。

questions.stem: He wanted the broken castle gate ____ before the tourists came.
questions.explanation: want sth done:gate 被修补,过去分词 mended 作宾补。

questions.stem: From the boat, we saw the whole valley ____ in thick morning mist.
questions.explanation: see sth done:valley 被覆盖,过去分词 covered 作宾补。

questions.stem: The committee wants these old traditions ____ alive for many years.
questions.explanation: want sth done:traditions 被保持,过去分词 kept 作宾补。
